title: Eco-sustainable chitosan–PVA biocomposites reinforced with recycled alum: preparation, characterization, and antimicrobial assessment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5471-5489
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09668E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahmoud A. Abdelkawy, Abdelbaset Shoker, Badr Isamil Badr, Yehia A.-G. Mahmoud
This study presents a sustainable approach to valorize aluminum can waste by converting it into recycled potassium alum (Recy. Al), used as a reinforcing and bioactive filler in chitosan/poly(vinyl alcohol) (CS/PVA) biocomposites.
